long_biography.plain_text:
The Ercegović family developed a passenger-tourism business around Krilo Jesenice after generations of maritime work. Eugen prepared for a role in that enterprise at Split's maritime faculty, graduating in 1985. Commercial service on long-distance routes followed before he returned to work alongside his father Ante.

His responsibilities joined command at sea with design and management. A Dugi Rat hospitality-tourism trade recorded him as owner from 1991, while he also served in the management of Solsticij. Those corporate roles are historical, but together they show how he built on a family platform through training, operational experience and business leadership.
